blockers.description: Windows restricted-token helper repeatedly fails with CreateProcessWithLogonW error 1168 for direct in-place apply_patch, view_image, and Browser/IAB startup.
blockers.workaround: Create unified patch files under C:/tmp with apply_patch, apply them using git apply --recount, use escalated read-only shell commands when required, and use the previously approved standalone Playwright fallback for rendered QA.

blockers.description: Generic GSD planner/checker agents overran without producing artifacts.
blockers.workaround: Use the already-written and GSD-validated quick plan; do not repeat planning. The two read-only code/UX audits are summarized in this handoff.

decisions.decision: Use six destinations: Overview, Content, About, Homepage, Publishing, Settings.
decisions.rationale: Matches the user's requested ownership model and removes the empty Media destination.

decisions.decision: Content consolidates projects, photo collections, and articles; the persistent plus opens a three-choice creation dialog.
decisions.rationale: Prevents the top plus from immediately starting a project upload and keeps all content creation in one place.

decisions.decision: Use automatic prefers-color-scheme theming with neutral OKLCH tokens only.
decisions.rationale: User explicitly requested automatic black/white day-night behavior instead of the amber accent system.

decisions.decision: Use a native date picker for Site last updated; parse legacy month-only text to day one and serialize chosen dates as Last updated: Month D, YYYY.
decisions.rationale: Provides a real calendar picker while remaining compatible with the public site's one-line text renderer.

decisions.decision: About owns portrait and resume, Homepage owns last-updated/categories/selected work/code projects, Publishing owns all recent versions, and Settings owns favicon/repository/SEO.
decisions.rationale: Directly implements the user's requested content ownership and the Settings UX audit.
